# `kernel/navi/contracts/AgentGatewayContracts.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/navi/contracts/AgentGatewayContracts.js`

Strict public contracts for Navi-to-Navi messaging. This module owns canonical shapes and signing/AAD bytes only. It never owns keys, performs transport, or decides relationship authority. Those remain injected kernel concerns so an app cannot turn a valid shape into authority.

### `async verifyAgentCardAuthorityV1(value, { now = Date.now()`

Cryptographically verify the self-contained authority carried by an Agent Card. Live revocation, relationship, and monotonic-revision policy remain a separate kernel decision after this proof succeeds.

### `async verifyAgentEnvelopeAuthorityV1(value, senderCard, { now = Date.now()`

Verify one AgentEnvelopeV1 against the sender's self-contained, verified Agent Card. Shape and hash integrity alone never count as sender authority.

### `async verifyAgentSupervisionGrantAuthorityV1(value, { ownerCard, guardianCard, now = Date.now()`

Verify both parties' Navi signatures on a read-only supervision grant.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
